MISSION-CONTROL REGISTER

Data-dense and instrument-like rather than costume sci-fi.

· Space Grotesk (UI) + IBM Plex Mono (all data)
· Accents share chroma .13 / lightness .82 — only hue moves:
  cyan 210 primary · amber 75 attention · green 155 nominal · red 25 fault
· Corner brackets, 1px hairlines, faint 52px grid
· No decorative gradients, no glow for its own sake

Every figure on these boards is real output from the system — the offshore sheet, its tags, and the measured benchmark.
